title: SLA: inference availability, % (SLA 99.5, SLO 99.7, REQ-07)
query: AmlOnlineEndpointTrafficLog | summarize requests = count(), failed = countif(toint(ResponseCode) >= 500 or toint(ResponseCode) in (408, 429)) | extend availability_pct = round(100.0 * (requests - failed) / requests, 3), sla = 99.5, slo = 99.7

title: SLA: inference p95 latency per day, ms (SLA 500, SLO 400, REQ-08)
query: AmlOnlineEndpointTrafficLog | summarize requests = count(), p95_ms = percentile(TotalDurationMs, 95) by day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | extend sla = 500, slo = 400 | order by day desc

title: SLO: chat errors and p95 duration (errors under 1 %)
query: AppRequests | where Name has "/api/chat" | summarize requests = count(), error_pct = round(100.0 * countif(toint(ResultCode) >= 500) / count(), 2), p95_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95) | extend slo_error_pct = 1

title: KPI-1 model cycle time, minutes (target 120)
query: AppEvents | where Name == "retrain_completed" | summarize cycles = count(), median_minutes = percentile(todouble(Properties.duration_minutes), 50), worst_minutes = max(todouble(Properties.duration_minutes)) | extend target = 120

title: KPI-2 drift-to-production lead time, hours (target 24)
query: AppEvents | where Name == "model_promoted" and isnotempty(Properties.drift_to_promotion_hours) | summarize promotions = count(), worst_hours = max(todouble(Properties.drift_to_promotion_hours)) | extend target = 24

title: KPI-3 predictive quality at 7 days on the latest matured window (recall 0.80 at precision 0.60)
query: AppEvents | where Name == "model_evaluated" | top 1 by TimeGenerated | project TimeGenerated, pipeline_job = tostring(Properties.pipeline_job), recall_7d = todouble(Properties.recall_7d), precision_7d = todouble(Properties.precision_7d), recall_target = 0.8, precision_target = 0.6

title: KPI-4 promotion failure rate, 90 days, % (target 15)
query: AppEvents | where Name in ("model_promoted", "model_rolled_back") | summarize promotions = countif(Name == "model_promoted"), rollbacks = countif(Name == "model_rolled_back") | extend failure_pct = round(100.0 * rollbacks / promotions, 1), target = 15

title: KPI-5 planner satisfaction, 30 days, % helpful (target 80, REQ-09)
query: AppEvents | where Name == "feedback_given" | summarize votes = count(), helpful_pct = round(100.0 * countif(tobool(Properties.helpful)) / count(), 1) | extend target = 80

title: Health model, last 24 hours: inference, chat, pipeline, drift
query: union (AmlOnlineEndpointTrafficLog | summarize n = count(), bad = countif(toint(ResponseCode) >= 500 or toint(ResponseCode) in (408, 429)), p95 = percentile(TotalDurationMs, 95) | extend component = "inference", state = case(n == 0, "no traffic", bad > 0.005 * n, "down", bad > 0.003 * n or p95 >= 400, "degraded", "healthy")), (AppRequests | where Name has "/api/chat" | summarize n = count(), bad = countif(toint(ResultCode) >= 500) | extend component = "chat", state = case(n == 0, "no traffic", bad > 0.05 * n, "down", bad > 0.01 * n, "degraded", "healthy")), (AmlRunStatusChangedEvent | where Status in ("Completed", "Failed") and ExperimentName == "trainyard-training" | summarize n = count(), bad = countif(Status == "Failed") | extend component = "pipeline", state = case(n == 0, "no runs", bad == n, "down", bad > 0, "degraded", "healthy")), (AmlRunStatusChangedEvent | where Status in ("Completed", "Failed") and ExperimentName != "trainyard-training" | summarize n = count(), bad = countif(Status == "Failed") | extend component = "drift", state = case(n == 0, "no runs", bad > 0, "breached", "healthy")) | project component, state, n, bad

title: Monitor and pipeline runs (REQ-04)
query: AmlRunStatusChangedEvent | where Status in ("Completed", "Failed", "Canceled") | project TimeGenerated, ExperimentName, RunId, Status | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 50

title: Unit cost, USD: estimates from docs/cost.md; Cost Management holds the actuals
query: AppRequests | where Name has "/api/chat" | summarize chat_questions = count() | extend usd_per_question = 0.002, usd_per_train_month = 1.5, usd_per_retraining_compute = 0.05, usd_per_blue_green_day = 1.6
